subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped update of fourteen pinned GitHub Action revisions in workflows that can access repository, app, registry, and OpenAI secrets?
rationale: The mechanical pin updates are plausible, but selecting and accepting executable third-party workflow revisions across credential-bearing automation is a repository trust-boundary decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Verify and accept the revisions
options.body: Review the upstream release diffs and pinned commits, then merge only after the rebased head is clean and its affected workflow checks succeed.

options.title: Split sensitive action updates
options.body: Separate app-token and Codex-action upgrades from lower-sensitivity workflow action bumps if owners want narrower trust review.

options.title: Pause the grouped bump
options.body: Close or defer this aggregate update if the repository prefers independently reviewed action-version changes.

recommendation.title: Verify and accept the revisions
recommendation.body: Review the upstream release diffs and pinned commits, then merge only after the rebased head is clean and its affected workflow checks succeed.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the acceptance decision for GitHub Actions that execute with repository credentials and secrets.
